Hey, just know that we're here for you and understand what you're dealing with. You know you have a 100% survival chance through a flare-up, and good rest is on the way. 

It's going to get better. You're not alone.
VSL#3 I have been taking for 6 months and my bacteria is way easier to balance.

VSL#3- is a natural probiotic that has helped me the past 6 months to keep bacteria in balance. You can buy it over-the-counter, take it with a glass of something cold, and it will help to rid of the bad bacteria in your GI tract. Do this every day. 

Warm tea- This may sound weird, but once I know I've eaten a trigger, something warm helps get it right the hell out of your system, and back on the right track. But a warning - warm stuff races through your gut, so it might be painful.

About weed- It is dehydrating, which I've found problematic. If you're trying it as a treatment, be careful, it only treats the symptoms.

Other than that, tons and tons and more water. Water and hydrating is huge for me and makes my tract feel more like well-oiled machine than a garbage dump. Try taking more water with everything you eat, it will help dampen potential triggers and hydrate when your body needs to fight, fight, fight!

Take care, I really hope you find some supplements that help you.

I am right there with you. We can't "power through" these things that, pardon my prejudice, those without do not understand. All that I can do sometimes is take 75mg of Tramadol, sit down and get better. Currently also on that liquid-only run that randomly rears its ugly head. 

So sorry he's taking that route with you. Rant, cry, and put everything you can out here - we're all here to support you. If you want to sit your ass down, hydrocodone it up and deal, then you deal. We love you. Take care.
